name: Description list
summary: Data as label and value, like personal details or contract details. In code a <dl> in a section with a heading.
use: "My details", contract details, a summary before you submit.
avoid: Data to compare across many items: use Table.
anatomy: Items (slot) with _Description item: label, value, action (optional), divider.
figmaProps: On mobile the value goes below the label. Bind to breakpoint/description-list (Apply variable) to follow the screen size.
_Description item: Label / Value / Show action / Show divider
Turn the divider off on the last item.
reactProps: Without the card border, for example in a Modal.
behaviour: Label is 200 px wide. Below 600 px the value goes below the label.
a11y: Action per row: add the field name for screen readers ("Change email address").
content: Empty field: show "Not filled in" instead of nothing.
Show sensitive data only in part (•••• ••• 12).
do: Group in blocks of 3 to 7 rows with a clear title.
dont: A "Change" on every row and also in the header: pick one.
